title.narrative: Urban Services Improvement Investment Program - Tranche 5

description.narrative: Project 5 will finance the sewerage system in Zugdidi and Mestia, the secondary towns covered by the Investment Program. The first component of the project will support infrastructure investments to construct sewerage system in Zugdidi and Mestia, and benefit approximately 20,600 households in Zugdidi and a population of 6,500 in Mestia (including floating tourist population). The second component will include project implementation support.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
a. Residents’ access to safe sanitation increased from Nil in 2013 to 100% in 2021 for Zugdidi through provision of sewer connections to all existing 20,600 households.
b. 100% households headed by women in the region covered by 2024
13 Sep 2021 | Video: https://www.adb.org/news/videos/reliable-water-georgian-cities-and-towns
Loan 3291: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 12 Jan 2025
Loan 3292: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 12 Jan 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: The two contracts for the construction of a WWTP and 178 km sewerage network in Zugdidi will be completed by the end of 2020. The WWTP contract in Mestia was awarded in November 2019 and is expected to be completed in 2022.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43405/43405-027-apfs-en_7.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | May 2015: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//43405-027-iee-04.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Dec 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43405/43405-027-smr-en_7.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Construction of sewerage network in Zugdidi completed, turnover to UWSCG by end-Sept 2020. Actual length of sewerage network laid is 191 km.
Completion by end-Sept 2020.
Construction of WWTP in Zugdidi (Design-Build) on track for completion by end-Sept 2020. WWTP in Mestia (Design-Build) awarded on 8 Nov 2019. Completion of Mestia WWTP by 2022 because of initial delays due to inclement weather conditions.
Public awareness campaigns are actively conducted in Zugdidi.
Complied with.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/43405-027/main#project-tenders
